name: Roach Eater
source:
You are playing the role of Sasha, a human girl who woke up in Purgatory after her Death. Neither Hell nor Heaven, she must go through the process of finding herself a place to live. 

[From [url=https://ms-flower.itch.io/roach-eater]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演的角色是萨莎，一个死后在炼狱中醒来的人类女孩。无论是地狱还是天堂，她都必须经历一个为自己找到安身之所的过程。

[来自[url=https://ms-flower.itch.io/roach-eater]Itch.io[/url]]
